title: Delivery pay-out reporting of CUSPA and MTF securities (NSE Clearing)
purpose: Clients' purchases that are not to be paid out to their demat accounts: unpaid purchases kept in the client unpaid securities pledgee account (CUSPA) and MTF purchases kept for the MTF pledge.
linked: Written from Ledgerline's CUSPA items and MTF positions of the settlement
source: Flags from NSE Clearing circular NCL/CMPT/63669 (30 Aug 2024) on pay-out of securities directly to client demat accounts; other fields from the files sent

columns.name: CTMFlag
columns.note: C: paid out to the client's demat, pledged to the clearing member's CUSPA; T: pledged to the trading member's CUSPA; M: pledged to the trading member's MTF account (CSMFA)
